regimeSub: 10Y hits 5.29% (24-year high) then snaps back as buyers emerge; NFP Friday looms.
themes: 10Y yield pierces 5.29% intraday before dip-buyers step in per Reuters (Oct 2) → curve steepens to -41bps (2Y at 4.88%) as term premium reprices fiscal risk with Fed Funds parked at 4.0% and Williams' Dec hike still live

Williams (Sep 30) 'no urgency' stance keeps Nov FOMC as skip but Dec hike probability elevated → Aug CPI at 3.7% YoY and core PCE at 3.0% give Warsh cover to deliver 25bp in Dec despite Q2 GDP at 2.2%

Brent fades $1.22 to $102.31 (-1.2% d/d) as Saudi disruption fears ease → WTI at $92.87 still +2.7% WoW keeping energy inflation in play, gold holds $4202 as real rate compression attracts haven flows

SPX grinds to 7666 (+0.2% d/d) ahead of Sep NFP Friday → CNBC preview notes healthy hiring appetite but markets wary of upside surprise that locks in Dec hike; KOSPI +1.2% to 6982 as HBM demand sustains

headline: 10Y Treasury hits 24-year high at 5.29% before buyers emerge; markets hold breath for Sep NFP with Williams' Dec hike warning keeping stagflation regime intact.
